abstract:
Implementation of the paper "Beyond Action Residuals: Steering Robot Manipulation Policies with Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19919).

# Beyond Action Residuals: Steering Robot Manipulation Policies with Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning (ZPRL) [Dongjie Yu](https://manutdmoon.github.io/) *,1,2 , [Kun Lei](https://lei-kun.github.io/) *,2,3 , [Zhennan Jiang](https://jzndd.github.io/) 4 , [Jia Pan](https://www.ai.hku.hk/people/academic-staff/jpan) #,1 , [Huazhe Xu](http://hxu.rocks/) #,2,5 * Equal contribution # Corresponding authors 1 School of Computing and Data Science, HKU; 2 Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute; 3 Shanghai Jiao Tong University; 4 Institute of Automation, CAS; 5 IIIS, THU **TL;DR**: ZPRL is an RL finetuning framework that perturbs bottleneck latents to steer robot manipulation policies, achieving efficient steering and smooth robot actions. ## Installation 1. Clone the repository. 2. Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies. We used [mamba](https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge) for fast env management, but you can also use conda. Then add `export MUJOCO_GL=egl` to your `~/.bashrc`. If osmesa/glfw/glew issues still exist during training, check this [page](https://docs.pytorch.org/rl/0.6/reference/generated/knowledge_base/MUJOCO_INSTALLATION.html) for possible solutions. 3. Check your `~/.bashrc` and locate `MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX` or `CONDA_PREFIX`. Then add either or correspondingly to your `~/.bashrc` if there is no such command. 4. Install `robosuite` and `robomimic`. We use specific versions for both to leverage Python bindings of `mujoco` so we do not have to install `mujoco-py` and download more files. 5. We made a small patch to `robosuite` to correct its GPU rendering on the specified device and enable faster parallel simulation. Replace `/your/path/to/dependencies/robosuite/robosuite/renderers/context/egl_context.py` with [this](patches/egl_context.py) and replace `/your/path/to/dependencies/robosuite/robosuite/utils/binding_utils.py` with [this](patches/binding_utils.py). >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出ZPRL框架，通过强化学习对瓶颈潜在空间进行扰动（而非直接作用在动作空间），以微调已有的操作策略，实现高效的策略引导和更平滑的动作输出。


# 一、动机

> 现有的机器人操作策略微调（如动作残差方法）在利用大模型先验时效率低、动作不平滑，难以高效地引导策略向新任务或新环境适应。


# 二、方法

> 提出ZPRL框架，通过强化学习对瓶颈潜在空间进行扰动（而非直接作用在动作空间），以微调已有的操作策略，实现高效的策略引导和更平滑的动作输出。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 摘要未提供具体数值，但论文表明ZPRL在多个机器人操作任务上实现了更高效的策略微调，生成的动作比基线（如动作残差）更平滑；具体性能指标需参考原文（arXiv:2605.19919）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该工作与具身智能和机器人操作直接相关，启发在于将RL微调转移到潜在瓶颈空间可减少动作抖动并保留预训练策略的结构，未来可探索与其他预训练策略的兼容性。
